name: background-gradient
title: Background Gradient
blurb: Animated radial gradient wrapper, glowing on hover with flowing colors.
description: A container that wraps children with a continuously animated multi-color radial gradient background. Uses Framer Motion to shift backgroundPosition, with opacity and blur effects. Gradient opacity increases from 60% to 100% on hover.
use_when: Card backgrounds, buttons, or sections needing a premium animated glow effect.
avoid_when: High-performance mobile contexts; continuous animation may cause frame drops. Users with prefers-reduced-motion should…
a11y: Purely decorative wrapper. Animation runs unprompted; no `prefers-reduced-motion` guard detected. Content inside remains fully accessible.
